title: Procedure letter extraction schema
description: Field definitions only. The engine wraps each field as {value, evidence_quote, page} when asking the model, so every value is traceable to the source text.

patient_name.description: Patient name exactly as written in the salutation, including title.

letter_date.description: Date of the letter. ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.

procedure_name.description: Name of the procedure, including side if stated, e.g. 'Cataract surgery (right eye)'.

procedure_plain_english.description: The letter's one-sentence plain-English description of the procedure.

appointment_date.description: Date of the procedure. ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.

location.description: Unit, floor and hospital where the patient should go.

stay_type.description: Type of stay, e.g. 'day case' or 'overnight'.

expected_duration_hours.description: How many hours the patient should expect to be at the hospital.

last_food_time.description: Latest time solid food may be eaten, as ISO datetime YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM. Null if the patient can eat normally.

last_clear_fluids_time.description: Latest time clear fluids / water may be drunk, as ISO datetime YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM. Null if no restriction.

bowel_preparation_required.description: True if the patient must take bowel preparation.

medicine_instructions.description: Each instruction about medicines, one sentence per item, as written.

items_to_bring.description: Things the patient should bring, one per item.

escort_required.description: True if someone must take the patient home.

escort_hours.description: How many hours an adult must stay with the patient afterwards. Null if not stated.

no_driving_days.description: Number of days the patient must not drive, if a fixed number is given. Null if the advice is conditional.

driving_advice.description: The driving advice sentence as written.

recovery_summary.description: What recovery is expected to be like, as written.

warning_signs.description: Symptoms that mean the patient should get help, one per item.
